statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit. Search/product/sign-in flows encountered eBay anti-abuse/error states; those states are reported as observed path issues rather than omitted checks.

page.framework: Server-rendered marketplace with Marko-style component markup and client enhancement
page.notes: Public marketplace. Homepage/category/sign-in were inspected; search and item routes failed under clean headless profiles. Checkout, authenticated account management and seller flows were not covered because they require identity/payment and risk side effects.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page stayed white under prefers-color-scheme: dark and reports color-scheme: normal.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, no active animations were present and authored rules disable transforms/skeleton/video transitions.
Text, search controls, consent buttons and focus outline remained visible under prefers-contrast: more.
No authored View Transition rules were found and tested route swaps were abrupt.
No parallax/scrollytelling effect requiring scroll handlers was observed; horizontal carousels use CSS scroll-snap and the mobile layout recorded no scroll long tasks.
Carousels use scroll-snap-type, scroll-snap-align and scroll-snap-stop with native overflow scrolling.
The 3,434px page uses static multi-row chrome and exposes no scroll-state query/progress treatment.
Custom menus/dialogs are present without authored anchor positioning/fallback rules.
Category breadcrumbs, explicit carousel previous/next labels and a single prominent search action preserve orientation and indicate movement.
The fixed consent notice obscures most first-view content, especially at 360x800.
There are no dialog/popover/details elements despite multiple role=dialog structures and keyboard traps.
On mobile the fixed consent chrome consumes most of the 800px viewport and clips the content headline.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout metrics on two templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and category both report scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, viewport meta present and 0px horizontal overflow.
Authored @container rules adapt cards, grids, video and banners at multiple inline-size thresholds.
Focus is visible, but many links and category controls are only 13–22px high.
The eBay identity and “Search for anything” field with prominent Search button make the marketplace purpose and next action clear.
Search and product returned generic errors; sign-in later required verification before the requested flow.
Failure states clearly say what happened and provide go-back/home or verification actions rather than a blank shell.
Lighthouse LCP was 17.8s/TBT 370ms; trace LCP was 5.75s with four long tasks.
Homepage and category CLS were 0; sign-in CLS was 0.052, all within the good threshold in observed loads.
Observed long tasks and 9.6s main-thread/4.6s JavaScript execution exceed a light startup budget.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, DOM confirmation and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: 108 requests/3.37MB with high-priority parser styles; Lighthouse estimated 910ms blocking savings. DOM confirms styles in head and several scripts deferred/async but others late synchronous.
Estimated unused payload: 656KiB JavaScript and 144KiB CSS, plus 55KiB legacy JavaScript.
Nine aria-hidden/focusable subtree failures and 29 images without alt were detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility plus visual contrast conditions
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse raised no color-contrast failure; normal and prefers-contrast screenshots keep text/control boundaries legible.
Lighthouse found no effective main landmark during consent and focusable descendants within aria-hidden header/main subtrees.
Body and heading text remain readable with clear spacing and no clipping except where the consent overlay physically covers content.
Reflow has no horizontal overflow, but many active targets are materially below an inclusive touch size.
The errors-in-console audit passed with zero items.
Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but all 79 images lack intrinsic width/height and many lack responsive candidates.
Unload listener blocks BFCache; two source-map problems were found. No prompt-on-load failure was reported.
Homepage has descriptive title/meta description in raw and rendered HTML; category has a descriptive title.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, robots and anchor probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport and robots are valid and links use real hrefs, but Lighthouse found a non-descriptive link.
Homepage exposes canonical plus broad hreflang; robots.txt is 200 and declares seven sitemap indexes with no accidental page noindex observed.
Homepage exposes complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata; the category exposes schema.org BreadcrumbList matching its visible breadcrumb.
HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff are present and no exposed secrets found, but CSP is absent and multiple cookies are not Secure.
Before consent, no known tracker domain was detected; most cross-origin bytes are eBay-owned CDN/static hosts, and Accept/Decline/Customise are equally available.

checkOutcomes.method: Sign-in DOM and Lighthouse prompt audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the exposed sign-in path showed password/social options without a visible passkey action.
HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN exist; CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy do not, while meta referrer is unsafe-url.
Homepage raw coverage is 86%, but Electronics category is 5%/isJsShell with raw title/H1/description absent; a bot challenge may contribute.
Menus, consent and verification states remained within viewport bounds; mobile templates had no horizontal clipping and errors retained recovery actions.
eBay commerce transactions intrinsically require current network, inventory and account state; installability/offline transaction support is not a reasonable core requirement for this audit.
checkOutcomes.reason: eBay commerce transactions intrinsically require current network, inventory and account state; installability/offline transaction support is not a reasonable core requirement for this audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTP/anti-abuse failures render a stable explanation and a homepage/go-back recovery rather than a blank screen.
html lang=en-US, extensive hreflang alternates and authored margin/padding inline logical properties are present.
The US locale surface uses localized English/currency-oriented commerce content and publishes locale-specific alternates rather than one undifferentiated page.
Live-event text includes ambiguous “6pm CST” zone abbreviations.
Consent copy names 24 partners and purposes; Accept All and Decline All have equal visual weight, with Customise and withdrawal route visible.
System failures avoid blaming the user, explain the state, and present homepage/back or verification recovery.
Username and password fields use autocomplete=username and current-password; controls have clear visible labels.
The item path returned a generic error and sign-in escalated to verification, preventing review/continuation of the commercial/account journey in a clean session.
All inspected images are WebP, but 52/79 lack srcset and 25 are oversized relative to display.
108 startup requests coincide with large unused code estimates and 9.6s main-thread work.
2.67MB/87 requests came from non-www origins, mainly eBay CDN/static, with 1.79MB images; media dominates the first load.
No WebMCP/agent tool registration was found on this agentic-commerce candidate.
No essential homepage task requires on-device generation or summarisation; adding inference without a concrete user benefit would be wasteful.
checkOutcomes.reason: No essential homepage task requires on-device generation or summarisation; adding inference without a concrete user benefit would be wasteful.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Ten menu toggles were followed by a 29.3MB self-size and 204,196-node increase, but separate-session variability limits attribution.
Loaded state used ~46.8MB JS heap/2,541 DOM elements; post snapshot contained 868,816 heap nodes and 66.9MB self-size.
Neither heap summary listed Detached* constructors among retained top populations, and repeated toggles completed without a growing visible DOM surface; listener instrumentation was not available.

paths.description: Marketplace homepage and global navigation, representing the public entry and discovery surface.
Electronics category, representing browse/listing templates and breadcrumb navigation.
Laptop search results, representing the primary search journey. A clean headless session received eBay’s generic error page.
A product detail linked from the homepage, representing item and purchase entry. The route returned a 403/generic error to the audit client.
Sign-in form, representing authentication and input assistance. One load exposed the form; later loads triggered verification.

findings.summary: The public surface does not adapt to the user’s dark-mode preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains white, and the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal", body background rgb(255,255,255).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and map surface/text tokens through light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme, including consent UI.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not expose View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The modern-CSS probe found no authored view-transition rule, while search and product navigations changed abruptly to generic error pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for supported browse and state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Global chrome remains static rather than responding to scroll state.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or scroll progress treatment on the long 3,434px homepage; the header consumes a fixed multi-row block.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight shrinking header where it improves orientation without hiding navigation.

findings.summary: Menus and dialog-like overlays do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains custom role=dialog/menu structures, but CSS inspection found no authored anchor-name/position-anchor/position-try placement rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for menus and anchored overlays.

findings.summary: The consent banner dominates the first view and obscures the marketplace content.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show the banner covering most content below navigation; at 360x800 it covers roughly 570px and leaves the hero title clipped behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent presentation; retain equally prominent Accept/Decline/Customise controls and easy later reversal.

findings.summary: Dialog-like surfaces are built from generic elements rather than native dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: The semantic probe found 0 <dialog>, 0 popover and 0 <details>, while the rendered DOM contains multiple div role=dialog surfaces and manual keyboard-trap boundaries.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal flows and popover for transient menus, preserving declarative light-dismiss and focus behavior.

findings.summary: Many navigation controls have undersized hit areas.
findings.evidence: The active probe found visible links/buttons only 13–22px high, including Sign in, register and category expand controls; focus itself was visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive boxes to at least a comfortable 44–48 CSS px where possible, without reducing visible focus.

findings.summary: Core search, item and account paths are unreliable for a clean browser session.
findings.evidence: The laptop search and homepage-linked item both returned “Something went wrong on our end”; sign-in later switched to a verification gate. Search/product content and purchase actions could not be reached.
findings.suggestedFix: Review anti-abuse thresholds and provide a recoverable challenge that preserves the requested destination; instrument the error code and offer a direct retry.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is well outside the good range in the audited condition.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 17.8s, FCP 8.9s, TBT 370ms and performance 0.47; the raw-CDP trace corroborated LCP 5.75s and four long tasks. Bot-challenge overhead affected the run but is part of the observed clean-session path.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, avoid challenge redirects for legitimate clients, defer non-critical work, and remeasure field LCP/INP/CLS.

findings.summary: JavaScript execution keeps the main thread busy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 9.6s main-thread work and 4.6s JavaScript execution; the trace records four >50ms tasks and 111.6ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long work into yieldable tasks, remove unnecessary startup execution, and load modules only when their surface is used.

findings.summary: The critical delivery path is heavy and contains blocking work.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 108 requests and 3.37MB transferred, including 1.22MB script and parser-inserted high-priority styles; Lighthouse found 910ms render-blocking savings and an 11.5MiB payload in its throttled run.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical chain, preload only proven LCP resources, defer non-critical scripts, and improve cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 656KiB unused JavaScript, 144KiB unused CSS and 55KiB legacy-JS savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by homepage module, remove legacy output for modern browsers, and conditionally load account, media and tracking features.

findings.summary: Hidden/focusable content and image alternatives produce an invalid accessibility tree.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found nine aria-hidden containers with focusable descendants and an accessibility score of 0.94; the image probe found 29 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove hidden controls from the tab order, expose only the active header/main tree, and provide meaningful alt or explicit empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: The consent state removes the main landmark and leaves focusable descendants in aria-hidden subtrees.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark because main#mainContent has role=presentation and aria-hidden=true, while controls inside hidden header/main containers remain focusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real main landmark and native modal focus management; when inerting background content, ensure descendants cannot receive focus.

findings.summary: Reflow works, but target sizing does not meet an inclusive touch baseline.
findings.evidence: Mobile layouts had zero horizontal overflow, yet the target probe found dozens of visible controls below 24px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the successful fluid reflow and enlarge hit boxes independently of text size.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive candidates.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found all 79 images missing width/height attributes, 52 missing srcset and 25 oversized; Lighthouse independently flagged 26 unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and responsive srcset/sizes for content images.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling blocks BFCache and developer diagnostics are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unload listener, an actionable BFCache failure, one missing source map and one source-map 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange where needed and publish valid source maps to restore BFCache and diagnostics.

findings.summary: At least one crawlable link lacks descriptive text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored 0.92 and identified one non-descriptive link; the DOM probe also found empty anchors whose accessible naming depends on descendants.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every destination a stable accessible name and descriptive anchor text without relying on transient visuals.

findings.summary: The HTTPS response lacks CSP and several cookies are not marked Secure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no Content-Security-Policy. Cookie evidence shows multiple .ebay.com cookies with secure=false and SameSite=None, although HSTS is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and mark HTTPS-only cookies Secure; narrow SameSite=None to cookies that truly require cross-site delivery.

findings.summary: The exposed sign-in entry does not offer a phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: A successful sign-in DOM load exposed username/current-password fields and social providers, but no passkey/WebAuthn action; no permission prompt occurred on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey sign-in/conditional mediation alongside existing recovery and federated options.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The main response has HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN, but no CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. The document meta referrer value is unsafe-url.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types policy where compatible.

findings.summary: A representative category exposes little useful content to a no-JavaScript crawler.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 86% raw-content coverage on the homepage but only 5% on Electronics, with missing raw title/H1/description and isJsShell=true. A bot challenge affected that category request, so confidence is medium.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render category identity and core listing links, and make anti-abuse responses crawler-aware without serving empty shells.

findings.summary: Event copy exposes ambiguous zone abbreviations.
findings.evidence: Homepage accessibility text includes live-event labels such as “6pm CST”; CST is ambiguous globally and can be wrong across daylight-saving transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Render localized zone names or explicit IANA-zone-derived offsets with Temporal/Intl, while storing instants unambiguously.

findings.summary: Modern formats are used, but responsive image delivery is incomplete.
findings.evidence: All 79 inspected images were WebP, but 52 lacked srcset, 25 were over 2× their display size and 79 lacked intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep WebP/AVIF, add srcset/sizes, and request CDN variants close to rendered dimensions.

findings.summary: Startup work and fetching are disproportionate for the first view.
findings.evidence: The homepage made 108 requests; Lighthouse found 656KiB unused JS, 144KiB unused CSS and 9.6s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate below-fold/live modules behind visibility, batch telemetry, and conditionally import feature code.

findings.summary: Cross-origin CDN/media bytes dominate the cold load.
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 2.67MB and 87 requests to non-www origins, mostly eBay-owned image/static hosts; images were 1.79MB. No known third-party tracker domain was detected before consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce initial media count, defer below-fold carousels, and enforce per-template byte/request budgets.

findings.summary: Agentic commerce capabilities are not exposed as structured tools.
findings.evidence: The rendered/source probe found no WebMCP registration, while product/category capability is otherwise exposed only through links and forms.
findings.suggestedFix: Pilot narrowly scoped WebMCP tools for search, item inspection and cart intent with explicit confirmation for side effects.

findings.summary: The repeated-menu snapshot retained substantially more heap than baseline.
findings.evidence: After ten open/close toggles, the heap summary was 66.9MB/868,816 nodes versus 37.6MB/664,620 baseline. Separate fresh sessions and anti-bot variability confound attribution, so this is low-confidence leak evidence requiring same-session retest.
findings.suggestedFix: Reproduce in one DevTools session with baseline/target/final GC snapshots; inspect retained menu DOM, closures and challenge code before fixing.

findings.summary: The homepage has a large JavaScript/DOM memory footprint for an entry page.
findings.evidence: The loaded page reported about 46.8MB used JS heap and 2,541 live DOM elements; the post-interaction snapshot totalled 66.9MB self-size and 868,816 heap nodes.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-mount below-fold modules, release hidden carousel/media state and profile the largest native/code allocations.

taskList.title: Stabilise clean-session search, item and sign-in journeys
Cut LCP, startup JavaScript and critical resource weight
Fix consent modal semantics and reduce first-view obstruction
Deploy CSP and complete cookie/browser policy hardening
Increase touch target sizes while preserving reflow/focus
Profile and bound homepage memory across repeated interactions
Improve navigation motion, scroll state and overlay positioning
Repair metadata, link naming and platform hygiene
Offer passkeys and structured agent capabilities
